title: What are you doing this weekend?
content_html:
I have yet another text editor I’ve written that I need to get cleaned up and released.

I have about 50% of a new scripting language interpreter written. Need to get that moved forward.

I gotta flip the new clothes dryer door to open on the other side.

I have some paperwork to do for the guardianship of my father.

An old friend/colleague is going to be in town, so meeting him for coffee.

And my older kid has some sort of school event, I need to nail down the specifics.

And I’d like to have a nice dinner just me and my wife, we haven’t had a true date night in a bit.

Phew.
